Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — Medicore's security team has a few follow-ups so we can close our SIG/SOC2 intake. We're specifically trying to validate: 

- SCIM delta delivery and reconciliation logs (we need timestamped deltas for the last 30 days)
- Sample SAML assertions showing our tenant attributes (NameID, groups, role) and an example of how you redact PII in assertions
- Evidence for ephemeral admin workflows (how sudo/jit-admin sessions are requested, approved, and revoked)

Can you provide an initial packet or point us to the secure artifact drop? Procurement would like to see an itemized list of deliverables + an estimated delivery ETA so they can align with our audit timeline.

Elena, Rishi — thanks. Quick technical notes and what we'll attach to the packet: 

1) SCIM deltas: we'll provide a CSV with these columns: event_id, timestamp_utc, user_id, operation (create/update/patch/delete), source (SCIM / manual), actor_email, changed_attributes (json-string), tenant_id. We'll redact full_email for any contractor rows when necessary but keep user_id mapping. Sample file: redwood_scim_delta_log_sample.csv (attached).

2) SAML assertions: we will include two redacted raw XMLs (saml_assertion_examples.txt) and a short mapping table showing how your AD groups map to Redwood roles. Raw PII (email, phone) will be replaced with consistent placeholders.

3) Ephemeral admin (JIT): deliverables are: ephemeral_admin_runbook.pdf (operational playbook), anonymized admin session audit excerpt (timestamped), and a short policy note describing TTL defaults (15 minutes for emergency JIT; 1 hour with approval for scheduled elevation).

Delivery plan: I can upload artifacts to a secure drive link and share DocuSign/ack checklist for you to sign. If Medicore needs logs in a specific schema (SIEM-friendly), let us know and we'll export a second CSV.

I will attach the three artifacts listed above and an initial evidence_delivery_map.xlsx (checklist + ETA). Expect the upload by 2025-05-23 10:00 PDT.

— Irene Choi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene — that sounds great. A couple quick clarifications before you upload: 

- For SCIM: please include a header row and use ISO8601 UTC timestamps (we need that for ingestion). The changed_attributes JSON string is fine.
- For SAML: we'll want one raw assertion showing the full NameID and groups, and one showing a redacted example (so our auditors can see the redaction approach).
- For Ephemeral admin: please include the approval workflow (who's allowed to approve) and the exact audit log fields we can expect to query (requester, approver, start_ts, end_ts, reason, session_id).

Procurement: when Redwood uploads the evidence_delivery_map.xlsx, can someone from procurement confirm a single recipient (sec-ops@medicore.com) for the secure drive link? We'll also need the signed checklist returned by Tue 2025-05-27 to stay on schedule.

Elena
